description: Reader supports existing state and Action Cloud v1 PayPal orders, exact capture verification, resumable tasks, private recovery, receipts and refund liabilities. This supporting release retains writer 4 and refuses live card purchases even if credentials are present. Activate writer 5 only in a separate release after this reader is verified on production. Once writer 5 is active, rollback requires a reader supporting version 5. No existing bindings, migrations or financial records are removed.
